title: Surveys

import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

A survey is the form a device shows. It is a list of questions with an id each, and it is **versioned**: every change publishes a new version, and devices keep answering the version they last downloaded until they sync.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/fk-surveys-intro" title="Designing a survey in Fieldkit" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Question Types

| Type | Answer | Notes |
| ---- | ------ | ----- |
| `text` | string | `max_length` defaults to 2000 |
| `number` | float | `min`, `max`, `step` |
| `choice` | string | `options` is required |
| `multi_choice` | list of strings | |
| `date` | ISO date | uses the device's time zone |
| `location` | `{lat, lon, accuracy}` | waits for a GPS fix unless `allow_stale` |
| `image` | asset id | compressed on the device |
| `signature` | asset id | |

## Creating a Survey

<Tabs syncKey="language">
<TabItem label="Python" icon="seti:python">
```python
survey = fk.surveys.create(
    name="soil-samples",
    questions=[
        {"id": "plot", "type": "text", "required": True},
        {"id": "depth_cm", "type": "number", "min": 0, "max": 200},
        {"id": "texture", "type": "choice", "options": ["sand", "silt", "clay", "loam"]},
        {"id": "where", "type": "location"},
    ],
)
```
</TabItem>
<TabItem label="TypeScript" icon="seti:typescript">
```typescript
const survey = await fk.surveys.create({
  name: 'soil-samples',
  questions: [
    { id: 'plot', type: 'text', required: true },
    { id: 'depth_cm', type: 'number', min: 0, max: 200 },
    { id: 'texture', type: 'choice', options: ['sand', 'silt', 'clay', 'loam'] },
    { id: 'where', type: 'location' },
  ],
})
```
</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Conditional Questions

A question with `show_if` is only asked when the condition holds. Conditions refer to earlier questions by id.

```python
{"id": "clay_colour", "type": "text", "show_if": {"texture": "clay"}}
```

:::note
Conditions are evaluated on the device. A condition that refers to a question later in the survey is accepted by the API but never true, because the answer does not exist yet when the question would be shown.
:::

## Versions

Publishing a change creates a new version. Old versions stay readable, and every submission records the version it answered.

```python
survey.update(questions=[...])
print(survey.version)        # 4
print(survey.versions())     # [1, 2, 3, 4]
```

:::tip
Removing a question does not remove its answers from earlier submissions. Exports include a column for every question that appeared in any version — see [Exports](/docs/exports).
:::

## Assigning Surveys to Devices

Surveys reach devices through [device settings](/docs/device-management#updating-devices), or through labels:

```python
survey.assign(labels={"team": "north"})
```
